# core: Settings

Part of [core](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core), PocketBase's Go package `core` as JavaScript sees it. The same types in Go: [core: Settings](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/core/settings).

## core.BaseAppConfig

BaseAppConfig defines a BaseApp configuration option

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `dbConnect` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core#coredbconnectfunc">DBConnectFunc</a></code> |  |
| `dataDir` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `encryptionEnv` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `queryTimeout` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration">time.Duration</a></code> |  |
| `dataMaxOpenConns` | <code>number</code> |  |
| `dataMaxIdleConns` | <code>number</code> |  |
| `auxMaxOpenConns` | <code>number</code> |  |
| `auxMaxIdleConns` | <code>number</code> |  |
| `isDev` | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| `appMigrations?` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core#coremigrationslist">MigrationsList</a></code> | AppMigrations, when set, is used instead of the global `AppMigrations` list by RunAppMigrations, RunAllMigrations, the jsvm plugin and the migrate command (see `AppMigrationsOf`). |
| `onLog` | <code>(log: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/logger#loggerlog">logger.Log</a>) =&gt; void</code> | OnLog, when set, is called with every log entry the app's logger accepts (before the logs settings decide whether it is stored), e.g. to copy them to a host's per-app log. It must not block or log. |

## core.collectionAuthOptions

collectionAuthOptions defines the options for the "auth" type collection.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `authRule?` | <code>string</code> | AuthRule could be used to specify additional record constraints applied after record authentication and right before returning the auth token response to the client. |
| `manageRule?` | <code>string</code> | ManageRule gives admin-like permissions to allow fully managing the auth record(s), eg. changing the password without requiring to enter the old one, directly updating the verified state and email, etc. |
| `authAlert` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coreauthalertconfig">AuthAlertConfig</a></code> | AuthAlert defines options related to the auth alerts on new device login. |
| `oauth2` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coreoauth2config">OAuth2Config</a></code> | OAuth2 specifies whether OAuth2 auth is enabled for the collection and which OAuth2 providers are allowed. |
| `passwordAuth` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#corepasswordauthconfig">PasswordAuthConfig</a></code> | PasswordAuth defines options related to the collection password authentication. |
| `mfa` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coremfaconfig">MFAConfig</a></code> | MFA defines options related to the Multi-factor authentication (MFA). |
| `otp` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coreotpconfig">OTPConfig</a></code> | OTP defines options related to the One-time password authentication (OTP). |
| `authToken` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coretokenconfig">TokenConfig</a></code> | Various token configurations --- |
| `passwordResetToken` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coretokenconfig">TokenConfig</a></code> |  |
| `emailChangeToken` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coretokenconfig">TokenConfig</a></code> |  |
| `verificationToken` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coretokenconfig">TokenConfig</a></code> |  |
| `fileToken` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coretokenconfig">TokenConfig</a></code> |  |
| `verificationTemplate` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core#coreemailtemplate">EmailTemplate</a></code> | Default email templates --- |
| `resetPasswordTemplate` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core#coreemailtemplate">EmailTemplate</a></code> |  |
| `confirmEmailChangeTemplate` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core#coreemailtemplate">EmailTemplate</a></code> |  |
